# MOD INFORMATION

This skin replaces base Nidalee with a custom model and texture after LoR's redesign.

It is a Nickyboi collaboration!

## ABOUT THE MOD

* This mod is created after Legends of Runeterra's redesign of Nidalee! Check out the original concept art here [https://www.artstation.com/artwork/Dvwmqo](https://www.artstation.com/artwork/Dvwmqo)
* And if you'd like to check out Nidalee's model on my artstation, you can do so here as well: [https://www.artstation.com/artwork/8BbJlE](https://www.artstation.com/artwork/8BbJlE)

## CREDITS

* Concept Art: [Lisha Du](https://www.artstation.com/ishutani)
* Splash Art: [Blade Byun](https://www.artstation.com/artwork/ao9Z6z)
* Model, Texture, & VFX: [Bearded Shepherd](https://linktr.ee/BeardedShepherd)

## EXTRA INFOS

* If you would like to support me personally, **Bearded Shepherd**, with the models and textures I create for custom skins made completely from scratch, please consider donating to my [PayPal](https://www.paypal.com/paypalme/DanielMatosArtwork)!
* You can also check out the [artstation post on Nidalee's model](https://www.artstation.com/artwork/8BbJlE) for a closer look.

Enjoy!
